description: Merge queue overrides, held inline while the model is proven in this canary. Once they have been demonstrated end to end they should move into a shared preset in digicatapult/renovate-config so other repositories can adopt them.

bumpVersion is unset because the base preset has Renovate write the next version onto its own branch. That is exactly the collision merge queue versioning removes: two Renovate pull requests would compute the same version and the second to reach the queue would be evicted.

v:patch is added because require-version-label gates every pull request on carrying exactly one v: label, and the base preset applies none. Without it every Renovate pull request would fail the gate and could never merge.
platformAutomerge uses GitHub native auto-merge so Renovate routes through the queue rather than merging around it via the API.

rebaseWhen conflicted replaces behind-base-branch from :rebaseStalePrs. The queue tests each pull request against trunk itself, so catch-up rebases are wasted CI, and pushing to a branch sitting in the queue evicts it.
